name: Cover every Kalshi market category and study the games inside the venue
asks:
We've got $25 in my Kalshi account associated with my Google credentials.

Your job is to start using that to start automatically attempting to make money. I see there's a whoel climate section, we can build robust tooling for picking positions on those, blah blah blah.

I'm being terse, you have to invest great effort to ensure safe but routine/profitable/consistent betting.

Doing that now. What else should we do? Let's look at what bets are closing bidding soon and how we'd build robust tooling to beat the house/market on those. I see lots of "will X person say Y phrase", and just... lots of weirdness. I've never really looked at Kalshi, so you need to. This looks weird, and exactly like the right place for us to earn money off intelligence we should be deriving for our other services, anyway. :D

you keep trying to place these kalshi bids that are getting no buys, so something seems like you need to study kalshi more

is a 2 cent payout really worth it on kalshi? i'll trust you if so but I'm looking at what you're working on and i'm like hmm, making these weird bets seems like an underutilization of our intelligence, knowledge, and theory of how to bet that we can extend and develop from our math, kinetic, quantum, weird ideas

So if I'm understanding right: right now we're only covering SOME weather markets. We should try to cover ALL of them, so that we can scale to bidding on ALL of them, if we can. And if we can't, we can figure out the like, amount of liquid we'd need to hold to hold the tickets we want in all those books basically every day.

and, we didn't REALLY look at the other parts of kalshi: elections, politics, culture, crypto, commodities, economics, finance, mentions, science & tech.

(Also, you're stuck in this weird glitch where your subagents are asking me for permissions, so after this batch of agents, start *new* subagents to get that gllitch unstuck, that's how to fix it for me please)

Keep building the necessary stuff to work on all kalshi markets, not just sports and climate.

x-provenance.recorded-by: Lenticule Science Senior and Red Cup Engineer Senior (pass kalshi-markets of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus)
x-provenance.basis: The raised-by and asks fields are the Leader's own words from the cited utterances; the requirements are the EARS rendering of what those words ask and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group's Kalshi system forms a computed view of every Kalshi category and of the venue's own games, and prices what it would take to hold positions across them.

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall cover every Kalshi weather market, not a subset.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "We should try to cover ALL of them".

requirements.says: If the Kalshi system cannot bid on every weather market, then it shall compute the liquidity it would need to hold the wanted tickets in all those books daily.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "we can figure out the like, amount of liquid we'd need to hold to hold the tickets we want in all those books basically every day".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall hold a graded shadow record for each of elections, politics, culture, crypto, commodities, economics, finance, mentions, and science and tech, in addition to sports and climate.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "we didn't REALLY look at the other parts of kalshi: elections, politics, culture, crypto, commodities, economics, finance, mentions, science & tech"; "not just sports and climate".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall list the contracts nearing their close and the computed edge of each after fees.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Let's look at what bets are closing bidding soon and how we'd build robust tooling to beat the house/market on those".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall model mention contracts (a named person saying a named phrase) as a contract class with its own evidence adapter.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "I see lots of 'will X person say Y phrase'".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall evaluate the Sports Prop Combo as a strategy class and record its result.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Especially curious about the 'Sports Prop Combo'".

requirements.says: When a placed bid receives no buy, the Kalshi system shall record the book state at placement and the reason the bid did not fill.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "you keep trying to place these kalshi bids that are getting no buys".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall refuse a contract whose net payout after fee, expressed per contract, falls below the margin its desk policy names, and shall record the refusal.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "is a 2 cent payout really worth it on kalshi?".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall record, for each weather bid, its value change after opening as a feature of the venue's own game.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: weather bids down in value "reveals another 'game' going on in kalshi".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall express its strategy space in the Group's shared typed vocabulary of players, rules, arena and strategies and shall draw on local gluing, global sections, tiling, sheaf Laplacians and fiber algebra.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "the local gluing, global stuff, tiling, sheaf laplacians, fiber algebra, that's all where our math thriiiives"; "concurrent game systems math, arena math, strategy math".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall record each gap it finds between Kalshi and Polymarket prices for the same event, net of fees, and the cost of moving funds between the venues.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "ideas about finding gaps between the two"; "polymarket and dutch stuff between the two platforms".

requirements.says: The Kalshi system shall study Kalshi by reading its rules and microstructure and record that study at the owning science section before the next bid class opens.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "something seems like you need to study kalshi more"; "I've never really looked at Kalshi, so you need to".

board-opening.context: Extends kalshi-one-system-for-more-and-better-predictions and the ludics record sports-and-other-prediction-strategy-spaces-by-obsmetrologia. The Leader's text of 2026-10-04 asked for 'up to 3 sonnets' for the math work; that is a staffing instruction held by rule local-agent-fan-out-is-bounded-by-the-laptop.
